headline: Casino Director Escapes Unhurt in Porvorim Shooting
summary: A casino group director and a guard escaped unharmed after being fired upon by two individuals in Porvorim. Police suspect the incident stems from an ongoing business rivalry.

headline: High Court Sets Jan 2 Deadline for Municipal Elections
summary: The Bombay High Court has directed that elections for 11 municipalities in Goa must be completed by January 2. The court emphasized that the government cannot delay polls for political convenience, leading the State Election Commission to begin ward delimitation.

headline: Goa Cabinet Clears Controversial Anti-Conversion Bill
summary: The Goa cabinet approved a strict anti-conversion bill proposing life imprisonment and heavy fines, which will be tabled in the upcoming assembly session. The move has sparked a political storm and drawn heavy criticism from Catholic groups who label it an election stunt.

headline: FDA Shuts Three Government Canteens Over Poor Hygiene
summary: The Food and Drugs Administration has ordered three government office canteens in Goa to stop operations. The closures follow the discovery of major structural flaws and kitchen hygiene lapses.

headline: CM Defends Drug-Free School Zone Directive Amid Criticism
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant stated that the directive to create 500-metre drug-free zones around schools is for awareness, not active policing. However, opposition leaders and critics have questioned the practicality and enforcement of the rule.

headline: SC Orders Regularisation of Long-Serving Goa PWD Workers
summary: The Supreme Court has cleared the regularisation of long-serving Goa Public Works Department workers, stating that the government cannot exploit labor.

headline: AAP MLA Meets Karnataka Minister Over Mhadei Issue
summary: A Goa AAP MLA met with Karnataka's Water Resources Department chief to discuss concerns over the Mhadei river diversion.

headline: Banks Disburse ₹468 Crore in Loans to Goa SHGs
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant announced that nationalised banks have extended over ₹468 crore in loans to support Self-Help Groups in the state.

headline: Activists Seek Meeting on Ballot Paper Voting in Goa
summary: NGOs and activists in Goa are seeking a meeting with the Chief Election Commissioner to demand the use of ballot papers instead of electronic voting machines.

headline: Kejriwal Promises to Ban E20 Petrol If AAP Wins Goa
summary: AAP leader Arvind Kejriwal vowed to ban E20 petrol in Goa within five days of taking office if his party wins the 2027 state elections.

headline: Raksha Mantri Inaugurates Re-developed Memorial at Patradevi
summary: Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh inaugurated the re-developed Hutatma Smruti Smarak at Patradevi to pay tribute to Goa's liberation satyagrahis.

headline: Three Arrested for Alleged Theft Lynching in Nuvem
summary: Police arrested three individuals after a man was allegedly lynched to death in Nuvem on suspicion of committing a theft.

headline: Major Liquor Smuggling Attempt Foiled at Patradevi
summary: Officials seized 400 boxes of illegal liquor hidden beneath onions and potatoes inside a vehicle at the Patradevi border check post.

headline: Photography Exhibition Showcases 20-Year-Old Daily Life Portraits
summary: A new exhibition in Goa features a photographer's collection of 20-year-old portraits capturing everyday life scenes.

headline: India Set for Historic Football Match Against Uruguay
summary: The Indian national football team is scheduled to face Uruguay in an upcoming international fixture.

headline: Two Hit-and-Run Victims Receive Compensation in Goa
summary: Financial compensation has been granted to two victims of hit-and-run accidents in the state.

headline: Goa University Introduces AI Elective for PG Students
summary: Goa University has introduced artificial intelligence as an elective course across all postgraduate programmes.

headline: Fire Destroys Three Vehicles in Navelim
summary: A major fire incident in Navelim resulted in the complete destruction of three vehicles.

headline: Relief for Unauthorised Structures in Goa CRZ Areas
summary: Owners of unauthorised structures located in Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ) areas have received major relief under new updates.

headline: Goa Launches Eleven-Temple Tour with Senior Citizen Discount
summary: The Goa government has launched a religious tourism initiative featuring an eleven-temple darshan circuit, offering a 50% fare concession for senior citizens.

headline: Sea Deities Appeased with Coconuts on Narali Poornima
summary: Devotees in Goa offered coconuts to the sea to appease marine deities on the auspicious occasion of Narali Poornima.

headline: Goa University Expands Campus Infrastructure with ₹100Cr Grant
summary: Goa University has utilized ₹100 crore in PM-Usha funds to build a 500-seater auditorium, new student hostels, and a futsal ground.

headline: Government Revives Goa Police Bill Ahead of Assembly Session
summary: The long-pending Goa Police Bill has been revived and is expected to be discussed in the upcoming state assembly session.

headline: Tillari CAD Board Defers Dhargalim Denotification
summary: The Tillari Command Area Development board has postponed the denotification of Dhargalim due to incomplete documentation.

headline: Health Minister Initiates Strict Surprise Checks on Facilities
summary: The Goa Health Minister has adopted a swift, pro-active approach to address administrative lapses and inspect healthcare facilities.

headline: Lords Hotels to Open New Premium Leisure Property in Goa
summary: Lords Hotels & Resorts has announced plans to soon launch a new premium leisure property catering to tourists in Goa.

headline: Fire Department Warns of Safety Risks in Old Goa Buildings
summary: While fire safety compliance has become much stricter following the Birch incident, the fire department flagged older buildings as a major blind spot.

headline: HC Orders Stray Dog Census as Population Ratio Soars
summary: The Bombay High Court has demanded census data on stray dogs in Goa after reports revealed that the stray animal ratio has quadrupled to nine percent.

headline: CM Flags Lack of Sports Awareness Among Students
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant raised concerns about poor sports awareness among students and questioned the role of physical education teachers in schools.

headline: Congress Demands Probe into Alleged ₹2,100Cr FAR Revenue Loss
summary: The Congress party has demanded an investigation into an alleged ₹2,100 crore loss in state revenue related to Floor Area Ratio (FAR) regulations.

headline: Demolition of Temple Shed Deferred Due to Law-and-Order Risks
summary: The demolition of the ‘Mormugao Cha Raja’ shed was postponed by authorities due to concerns over potential law-and-order disruptions.

headline: Congress Promises to Scrap Controversial Policies If Elected
summary: Congress leader Yuri Alemao announced that if the party forms the government in 2027, they will scrap several controversial state policies.
